sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM transactions WHERE tenure_code='F'

SELECT pt.property_type_name, COUNT(t.transaction_id) FROM property_types pt LEFT JOIN properties p ON p.property_type_code=pt.property_type_code LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.property_id=p.property_id GROUP BY pt.property_type_name
SELECT tt.tenure_name, SUM(t.price) FROM transactions t JOIN tenure_types tt ON tt.tenure_code=t.tenure_code WHERE t.date_of_transfer='2026-07-17' GROUP BY tt.tenure_name
SELECT nb.new_build_name, AVG(t.price) FROM transactions t JOIN new_build_flags nb ON nb.new_build_code=t.new_build_code WHERE t.ppd_category_code='A' GROUP BY nb.new_build_name
SELECT rs.record_status_name, COUNT(t.transaction_id) FROM record_statuses rs JOIN transactions t ON t.record_status_code=rs.record_status_code GROUP BY rs.record_status_name

SELECT d.district_name, AVG(t.price) AS avg_price FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON p.property_id=t.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code JOIN districts d ON d.district_id=p.district_id WHERE pt.property_type_name='Terraced' AND strftime('%Y-%m', t.date_of_transfer)='2026-07' GROUP BY d.district_name ORDER BY avg_price DESC, d.district_name LIMIT 1

SELECT pt.property_type_name, AVG(t.price) AS avg_price, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(t.price) DESC) AS rnk FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON p.property_id=t.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.date_of_transfer)='2026-07' GROUP BY pt.property_type_name
SELECT MAX(price) FROM transactions WHERE ppd_category_code='A'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE new_build_code='N' AND record_status_code='A'
SELECT SUM(price) FROM transactions WHERE date_of_transfer='2026-07-10'
SELECT p.town_city, COUNT(*) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON p.property_id=t.property_id WHERE t.price>=800000 GROUP BY p.town_city ORDER BY p.town_city

SELECT pt.property_type_name, MIN(t.price) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON p.property_id=t.property_id JOIN property_types pt ON pt.property_type_code=p.property_type_code WHERE t.tenure_code='F' GROUP BY pt.property_type_name ORDER BY pt.property_type_name

SELECT d.district_name, COUNT(*) FROM transactions t JOIN properties p ON p.property_id=t.property_id JOIN districts d ON d.district_id=p.district_id WHERE t.ppd_category_code='B' GROUP BY d.district_name ORDER BY d.district_name
